description: Defines the IBasketService interface for basket-related operations in the application core, including adding items, transferring baskets, setting quantities, and deleting baskets.

classes.name: IBasketService
classes.description: Interface for basket-related services, providing asynchronous methods to manipulate shopping baskets.

methods.name: TransferBasketAsync
methods.description: Transfers basket items from an anonymous session to a registered user.

methods.name: AddItemToBasket
methods.description: Adds an item to the user's basket with specified details.

methods.name: SetQuantities
methods.description: Sets quantities for multiple items in a basket, returning the updated basket.

methods.name: DeleteBasketAsync
methods.description: Deletes the basket with the given ID.
